oversampling.evidence: No synthetic sampling or resampling is present; class weights are estimator-local and learned only from training folds.

preprocessing_before_cv.evidence: Sentinel conversion, imputation, scaling, and one-hot encoding are pipeline steps fitted/used independently in each fold.

target_derived_features.evidence: No diagnosis flags, prior risk labels, recommendations, or symptoms were added.

target_leakage.evidence: Target columns are schema-validated and excluded from every feature set.

test_set_tuning.evidence: The project uses internal 5-fold CV. Model-development selection bias and absence of external validation are disclosed.

threshold_tuning.evidence: Outer-fold results use thresholds selected only from inner out-of-fold training predictions.
